tools.name: find_candidates
tools.description: Use when the user asks to find, shortlist or source an engineer, researcher or scientist from public work. Input: a role brief, a job description, or a public GitHub repository URL; be specific. Optional location only when the user requires one. Returns up to 20 people, each with the public sources

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Use after find_candidates when the user wants more on one person, or when they name a GitHub login or ORCID iD. Input: GitHub login, ORCID iD, or the id returned by find_candidates. Returns one profile with recent public activity. Not a full career history. Read only.

tools.name: find_similar_projects
tools.description: Use to map the landscape around a seed repository, for example before searching for people. Input: owner/name. Returns similar open source projects and their top contributors. This is not a shortlist; call find_candidates for that. Read only.
